subject: ClearWave evaluation: performance guardrails & acceptance matrix
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@clearwave.ai>, Alec Park <alec.park@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Oct 2026 15:32:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWave evaluation: initial recap + next steps

Hi Samantha / Alec —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the POC kickoff:

Summary from our discovery
- Goal: evaluate Redwood inference as an embedding + retrieval + generation path for ClearWave’s Summarize product (batch ingests + interactive agent).
- Primary constraints: 95th-pct latency goal for small prompt flows (< 400 tokens) under 250ms; sustained throughput target of ~180 reqs/s for peak windows; cost goal <= $0.0008 / token for long-run production.
- Quality: 88% match rate against your internal rubric on the test set (50 queries) and no high-severity hallucinations in 1k-run spot check.

Proposed POC acceptance matrix (high level) — see attached full plan: CLW-POC-Plan-20261011.pdf
- Performance gates:
  * Median latency (100–400 tokens): <= 120ms
  * 95th percentile latency: <= 250ms
  * Sustained throughput (simulated peak): >= 180 reqs/s with < 1% error rate
- Cost gates:
  * Cost-per-token (inference only): <= $0.0008/token at the recommended batching config
- Quality gates:
  * Accuracy/match >= 88% on agreed test queries
  * No critical hallucinations in manual audit (sample size 1k)
- Operational gates:
  * Model pinning and rollback tested
  * KV-prefix caching validated for repeat queries

Timeline proposal
- Week 0 (this week): confirm acceptance matrix & test set; contract signature / NDA in flight.
- Week 1: infra provisioned (dedicated trial cluster) + initial sync for dataset ingestion.
- Week 2: baseline benchmarking (no optimization) + quality evaluation.
- Week 3: performance tuning (quantization/ batching/ routing) + rerun benchmarks.
- Week 4: final acceptance run + handoff to ops for runbook.

Owners
- Redwood: Karthik (trial PM), Marcus Lin (performance lead)
- ClearWave: Samantha (product), Alec (platform)

Immediate asks for you:
1) Confirm the test set delivery date (CSV or S3 link) — target Wed Oct 14.
2) Sign-off on acceptance matrix and the three primary thresholds (latency, throughput, cost).
3) Share any compliance or IP constraints we should surface to our security team.

I’ve attached a draft POC plan and a small KPI template (performance-kpis-template.xlsx) you can fill out with your existing baselines. If that looks good I’ll loop in our security lead and get procurement aligned.

Best,
Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Attachments: CLW-POC-Plan-20261011.pdf (POC plan, roles, test harness details), performance-kpis-template.xlsx (benchmark sheet)

From: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@clearwave.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Alec Park <alec.park@clearwave.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearWave evaluation: initial recap + next steps

Thanks Karthik — solid summary. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Test set: we can provide an S3 bucket with 2 files — 50 golden queries for accuracy checks and a 1k sample for hallucination audit. ETA: 2026-10-14 EOD.
2) Latency: 250ms 95th-pct is our external SLA — internally we’d like to aim for 200ms if possible, but we’ll accept 250ms for the POC acceptance.
3) Throughput: 180 reqs/s is accurate for peak windows; we also need an additional sustained 30 reqs/s background workload for batch ingestion flows.
4) Compliance: we are in the process of completing a standard security questionnaire — can you confirm who on your team will be the contact for SOC2 evidence and network diagrams?

Small ask: can you provide a short checklist of what telemetry/logs Redwood will make available during the trial (token-level cost, per-request latency, model-version id)? That will help our infra team instrument load tests.

If all the above is feasible, we can aim to sign the trial SOW early this week.

Thanks,
Samantha
Samantha Reed | Head of Product | ClearWave AI

---
Note: S3 bucket name will be shared in a follow-up separate email with access keys.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@clearwave.ai>, Alec Park <alec.park@clearwave.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearWave evaluation: initial recap + next steps

Samantha — great, thank you for the fast turnaround. Quick answers and updates inline:

- Test set: perfect. Once you share the S3 path I’ll confirm ingestion steps and schema expectations (we accept CSV, JSONL).
- Latency: we’ll treat 200ms as an optimization target; 250ms is the POC acceptance gate. We’ll log both median and p95 for the runs.
- Throughput: noted on the extra 30 reqs/s background work — we’ll include that in the load profile for the peak run.
- Compliance contact: Lauren Bishop (cc’d) will be the primary contact for SOC2 evidence and network diagrams. Lauren — can you confirm SLA for doc turnaround?

Telemetry we expose during trials (short checklist) — I’ll paste here and attach to the plan:
- Per-request latency (median, p50/p90/p95/p99), by model-version id
- Token counters (input/output) and raw token cost estimate by run
- Batch size distribution and queueing stats
- Error / exception traces + request ids for debug
- Runtime metrics (GPU utilization, memory footprint) for perf tuning

Next practical steps: I’ll update the POC PDF with the clarified throughput profile and optimization target (200ms). Marcus, can you propose an initial benchmark job and the synthetic load script by EOD today?

Thanks — I’ll follow up once Marcus drops the scripts.

Best,
Karthik

On Tue, 13 Oct 2026 at 07:42, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com> wrote:
> Karthik / Samantha — attaching a quick template for a load script (we’ll convert to JMeter/Locust as needed).
>
> Proposed baseline run (week 2):
> - 10k requests at 1x background + 180 reqs/s peak for 10 minutes
> - Measure p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, and GPU utilization
> - Export raw traces to S3 for your audit
>
> I’ll publish the script to the Drive link and include instructions for parameterizing the token lengths.
>
> Marcus

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Reed <samantha.reed@clearwave.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: ClearWave evaluation: initial recap + next steps

Samantha — I’ll be your point for security/compliance evidence. Quick timeline from our side:
- Today/Tomorrow: I’ll share SOC2 in-scope evidence checklist + network diagram (redacted topology for trial).
- 48 hours after SOW: we can provide temporary signed access to audit artifacts (read-only).
- Procurement: for the trial we’ll issue a trial SOW (14-day evaluation) — if you need a purchase order or amended terms, share your procurement contact and we’ll route it.

Also adding a small note on billing: trial usage will be covered under a bill-credit arrangement and we’ll provide a usage report (token counts + estimated cost) at the end of the trial. If you prefer a pre-paid credit, we can do that as well.

Lauren Bishop | Head of Security & Compliance | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced in thread: CLW-POC-Plan-20261011.pdf, performance-kpis-template.xlsx
